description: Pro. Fetch up to 10 public pages, run the static accessibility audit on each, and return a draft Accessibility Conformance Report in the shape of the ITI VPAT 2.5 WCAG edition: a report header (product, version, date, evaluation methods, contact, notes), then a table of every WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA success criterion (55, including 2.4.11, 2.5.7, 2.5.8, 3.2.6, 3.3.7 and 3.3.8; 4.1.1 Parsing is omitted because it is obsolete in 2.2). Each row has a Conformance Level of exactly Supports, Partially Supports, Does Not Support, Not Applicable or Not Evaluated, plus remarks. Rows are marked Does Not Support or Partially Supports only where the audit found a real issue, citing the page and the count. Rows that do not apply (no media, no forms, no drag or gesture code) are Not Applicable and state what was searched. Rows only a person can judge (keyboard use, focus order, captions quality, images of text) are Not Evaluated with a two-step test. Supports is used where the HTML, stylesheets and same-site scripts show no failure, and the remark states what was and was not checked. The report carries a disclaimer that it is a draft from automated checks and not a legal conformance claim, and a Manual testing still needed section. Pass `urls` (array, up to 10) or one `url`; productName, version, vendor, contactEmail and evaluator are optional header fields. Returns an object with `report` (markdown), `criteria` ([{criterion, name, level, remarks}]), `pages` and `counts`. Do not present the output to a customer as a finished VPAT.

evaluator.description: Person or team who ran the evaluation

productName.description: Product name for the report header

url.description: A single public page URL, instead of urls

urls.description: Up to 10 public page URLs that represent the product (home, a form, a content page, sign-in)

name: generate_conformance_report
title: Conformance report
